title: KV-cache rotation caused tenant metrics omission and span compaction gap - incident remediation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Customer escalation: multiple tenants reported dashboards showing zeroed heatmap tiles and missing GPU/memory metrics across Hosted/Dedicated/Private environments during a production incident. Tracing returned incomplete span chains for requests that had high tail latency. Root cause investigation identified an interaction between a recent KV-cache index rotation optimization and a background span compaction job which together produced temporary shard tombstones and a short-lived index gap. This ticket captures the fix, mitigation, rollout, customer comms, and follow-ups.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Deploy current runtime with KV-cache index rotation enabled and compaction job configuration from runtime-1.18
2) Simulate tenant ingestion burst with high-frequency short traces and metric points from GPU hosts
3) Trigger index rotation window (alignment with watermark) during ongoing ingestion
4) Observe missing recent metric points in dashboard heatmaps and broken trace parent-child stitching for spans created around rotation window
mitigation_actions: Rolled back index rotation parameter to the previous grace window (from 30s -> 5m) as emergency rollback on all affected rings
Paused background compaction job for affected clusters and kicked WAL replay to rehydrate recently tombstoned indices
Applied temporary routing rule to route reads for impacted tenants to the stable replica (Dedicated: pinned GPU pools)
Notified customers via incident channel and provided ETA for restoration and follow-up analysis
root_cause_summary: An optimization to rotate KV-cache indices aggressively during periods of low activity assumed that compaction would not run concurrently for newly-rotated segments. Under bursty ingestion, compaction ran during rotation and removed recently-written index fragments due to an off-by-one watermark calculation. The combination created a window where recent metric points and span references were not visible to the query layer, causing dashboard blanking and trace gaps. The change also exposed an insufficiently guarded feature flag that allowed the rotation to run on tenants with very low retention windows (Private deployments).
engineering_notes: Primary fix: adjust rotation logic to consult compaction-in-flight flag and to require completed WAL checkpoint before rotation finalization
Patch applied: runtime repo PR #1298 modifies rotation codepath; adds a leader-guard and extends rotation grace window for tenants with retention < 24h
Compaction bugfix: change compactor to check recent write watermark (PR #1301) and to avoid GC of segments younger than watermark+60s
Added deterministic unit + integration tests that simulate concurrent rotation+compaction
Added a canary that asserts no >1m metric ingestion visibility gaps in 3 consecutive 5m windows before enabling rotation on a ring

3) Create a backfill automation story to replay missing metric points for any tenant affected by rotation/compaction windows
4) Update on-call playbook: steps to detect concurrent rotation+compaction, and commands to safely pause compaction
5) Evaluate retention defaults for Dedicated/Private tenants and add per-tenant rotation thresholds
